en_title: After Buying EA, Silver Lake and PIF Are Reportedly Now Seeking to Acquire Gaming Software Provider Unity
cn_title: 据报道，Silver Lake与PIF收购EA后，现正寻求收购游戏软件提供商Unity
opus_summary: 据路透社报道，Silver Lake和沙特主权财富基金PIF近期就收购Unity展开接洽，买方财团曾讨论约250亿美元(约合人民币1668亿元)的估值。Unity据称正咨询投资银行以评估选择，但谈判仍处于初步阶段，交易能否达成尚不确定。消息传出后，Unity股价在常规交易中上涨近15%。

paragraphs.en: A consortium of investors including private equity firm Silver Lake Partners and Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund PIF has held recent talks to acquire gaming software provider Unity.
paragraphs.cn: 一个由私募股权公司Silver Lake Partners和沙特阿拉伯主权财富基金PIF等投资者组成的财团，近期就收购游戏软件提供商Unity进行了谈判。

paragraphs.en: A Reuters report citing confidential sources familiar with the matter states that PIF and Silver Lake, the latter of which already owns 8% of Unity, approached the company in recent weeks. The buyer consortium discussed a valuation of about $25 billion before Unity’s latest earnings report, which lifted its market capitalization to roughly $21.5 billion.
paragraphs.cn: 路透社援引知情匿名消息人士报道称，PIF和已持有Unity 8%股份的Silver Lake在最近几周接洽了Unity。在Unity发布最新财报之前，买方财团曾讨论过约250亿美元的估值；该财报使Unity的市值升至约215亿美元。

paragraphs.en: Unity has reportedly been consulting with an investment bank to evaluate its options following the approach, however talks are preliminary and no deal is assured.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，在收到接洽后，Unity一直在与一家投资银行商讨，以评估自身的选择。不过，谈判仍处于初步阶段，无法保证一定会达成交易。

paragraphs.en: Should the acquisition go ahead, this would be another major investment into the games industry for Silver Lake and PIF. The two firms previously teamed up with Jared Kushner’s Affinity Partners to acquire Electronic Arts for $55 billion in a deal that was finalised in August . Since then the publisher has initiated major corporate restructurings and studio closures, most recently shutting development studio BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect game .
paragraphs.cn: 如果收购得以进行，这将是Silver Lake和PIF对游戏行业的又一次重大投资。两家公司此前曾与杰瑞德·库什纳的Affinity Partners联手，以550亿美元收购EA，该交易于8月完成。此后，这家发行商启动了大规模的企业重组并关闭了多家工作室，最近还关闭了开发工作室BioWare，并取消了下一款《Mass Effect》游戏。

paragraphs.en: Unity’s popular game engine and development tools have been used to create thousands of mobile, console, and PC games. These include Genshin Impact, Hollow Knight, Among Us, Subnautica, and Beat Saber, to name just a few. Notably, Unity’s tools are also used by Scopely, the developer of Monopoly Go!, and Niantic, the maker of Pokemon Go, both of which are owned by a group that includes Silver Lake, PIF, and Affinity Partners.
paragraphs.cn: Unity广受欢迎的游戏引擎和开发工具已被用于制作数千款移动、主机和PC游戏。其中仅举几例，就包括《Genshin Impact》《空洞骑士》《Among Us》《深海迷航》和《Beat Saber》。值得注意的是，《Monopoly Go!》的开发商Scopely和《宝可梦Go》的制作商Niantic也使用Unity的工具，这两家公司都由一个包括Silver Lake、PIF和Affinity Partners在内的集团持有。

paragraphs.en: Silver Lake has already invested $400 million into Unity and with its 8% stake it remains one of its largest shareholders. Since going public in 2020, Unity has expanded beyond its game engine business into advertising technology and broader real-time 3D software, and its tools are increasingly used in automotive design, filmmaking, architecture, and industrial simulation.
paragraphs.cn: Silver Lake已向Unity投资4亿美元，凭借8%的持股比例，它仍是Unity最大的股东之一。自2020年上市以来，Unity已从游戏引擎业务扩展至广告技术和更广泛的实时3D软件领域，其工具也越来越多地用于汽车设计、电影制作、建筑和工业仿真。

paragraphs.en: After news of the acquisition talks first broke, Unity shares rose nearly 15% in regular trading and sit at $48.80 per share at the time of writing.
paragraphs.cn: 收购谈判的消息首次传出后，Unity股价在常规交易时段上涨近15%，截至发稿时为每股48.80美元。
